response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), dev AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, avg_price - (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM inv) AS deviation FROM inv), cdev AS (SELECT dev.*, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS country_avg_dev FROM dev) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, deviation, deviation - country_avg_dev AS deviation_minus_country_avg FROM cdev ORDER BY (deviation - country_avg_dev) IS NULL, (deviation - country_avg_dev) DESC, InvoiceId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Country is the customer's Country (Customer.Country), not the invoice's BillingCountry, as the request says 'its customer's country'.
Invoice average is the simple average of InvoiceLine.UnitPrice per line, not weighted by Quantity.
Invoices with no lines are kept with NULL averages (ignored in the overall and country averages) and sort last.
Ties at the cutoff are broken by InvoiceId, which is one arbitrary choice.
